rationale.target_identity_four_fifths: Reduce the target-identity embedding relative to dynamic histories before LayerNorm.
rationale.target_identity_one_fifth_more: Opposite intervention to distinguish insufficient target separation from an overly strong static identity contribution.
rationale.shared_context_four_fifths: Reduce the shared history/calendar/geography path relative to target-specific local history.
rationale.shared_context_one_fifth_more: Opposite intervention on the same path.
rationale.calendar_one_tenth_more: Calendar weakening hurt the two latest seasons; test a small strengthening rather than removal.
rationale.level_circuit_reference_0.4: The circuit at reference 0.7 helped older seasons but hurt the latest; a lower explicit reference changes its level-dependent balance.
rationale.level_circuit_reference_0.55: Intermediate reference for the same programmed circuit.
rationale.level_plus_outer_tail: Combine the modest median circuit with the independently tested outer-tail expansion.
rationale.median_plus_outer_tail: Combine the initial median shrinkage with outer-tail expansion; both are direct saved-tensor edits.
